title: Compact catalog + localized pricing snapshot pack
creator: Asha Kumar
description: Design and deliver a set of release-ready UX screenshots and annotated assets for the Model Catalog and Pricing quickstart. Focus is on compact card variants for onboarding flows, localized pricing badges (USD/EUR/JPY), and deprecation states that will appear in release notes and the console quickstart. Deliverables should include annotated PNG/WEBP exports, alt-text snippets, Figma source links, and a short handoff checklist for engineering and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Three compact catalog card screenshots (desktop, tablet, mobile) at 2x export sizes
Localized pricing badges rendered for USD, EUR, JPY with currency subtext and compact unit rates
Model detail screenshot with deprecation ribbon state and 'replace with' recommendation overlay
Annotated callouts for onboarding copy (3 callouts max per screenshot) and accessibility alt-text for each image
All assets uploaded to Drive + Figma published file link and included in release-asset manifest
Design handoff notes added to PRD and docs ticket; PM sign-off recorded
comments: 2025-02-14 - Asha Kumar: Kickoff - aligned with PM on scope. Deliver three compact variants and one expanded detail for deprecation state. Intl required for en/fr/de/ja and sample currencies USD/EUR/JPY.
2025-02-15 - Miguel Ortega: Initial designs uploaded to Figma. Using compact grid with 3-column desktop and stacked mobile. Need engineering confirmation on 320px crop for mobile hero.
2025-02-16 - Hana Lee (PM): Quick review - love the compact layout. Request: make price badge 16px height on mobile and include 'per 1k tokens' microcopy.
2025-02-17 - Miguel Ortega: Updated exports with microcopy. Added deprecation ribbon variants: 'Deprecated', 'Legacy - see replacement'. Added notes for fallback color tokens.

2025-02-18 - Eng feedback (J. Patel): Confirmed 320px mobile crop; requested margin adjustments to avoid truncating model name on dynamic length. Added guidance to avoid >2-line model names in screenshots.
2025-02-19 - Design review (A. Kumar): Accessibility pass complete. Alt-text prepared. Contrast adjusted for currency badge to meet AA. Preparing final exports.

2025-02-20 - Miguel Ortega: Final assets exported and uploaded. Opened docs PR and attached manifest. PM Hana Lee approved for release notes hero slot. QA step: engineering to confirm visual parity after CSS variables applied. GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/872
notes_for_engineering: See handoff page in Figma for spacing tokens and export slices. Include both PNG@2x and WebP compressed exports. Ensure currency formatting is provided by the i18n layer: amount + unit line (e.g., "$0.40 / 1k tokens"). For deprecation ribbon use CSS class .ribbon--deprecated with accessible aria-label.
handoff_checklist: Figma source published and shared with engineering and docs
PNG 2x and WebP exports uploaded to Drive
Alt-text for all images added to assets manifest
